title: Uncraftable Tools
description: Simple datapack to  remove vanilla tool crafting recipes
body:
A simple datapack to remove the crafting recipes for vanilla tools.
This is neither difficult, nor tedious, but I was hoping someone had done the work for me, and when they hadn't. . . I figured I'd do it for any amatur modpack creators who want easy plug and play.

This datapack only removes the crafting recipes for tools. Vanilla tools may still be found as loot or be spawned on entities. 
This includes wood, stone, golden, iron, and diamond tools.
Diamond tools may still be converted to netherite (assuming you got the diamond tool in the first place). Tools may also still be combine-repaired in a crafting table.

Bows are not included in this for their use in dispensers.
